derivation: from H2603 (חָנַן) and H410 (אֵל); favor of God;
def: Channiel, the name of two Israelites

occurrences.text: The prince of the children of Joseph, for the tribe of the children of Manasseh, Hanniel the son of Ephod.
And the sons of Ulla; Arah, and Haniel, and Rezia.
